Name: Full height Abigail - SCA - Nyapu style
Author: Ash1307
Description:
My first mod ! <3 
I was impressed by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/178873845]ViolentFran[/url] with their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42083]Idle plus walk[/url] mod I wanted to give it a try and here I am. I based my work on [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/125586323]AlmostMidnight[/url]'s mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37438]Cuter Seasonal Nyapu Colored sprites[/url]. 

So, how to ? 

1. Download  and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42083]Idle plus walk[/url]﻿ (obviously) 
2. Donwload and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]
3. Download  and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37438]Cuter Seasonal Nyapu Colored sprites[/url] (for all the sprites I don't cover yet). Follow the suggestion on the mod page.
4. Donwload and install my mod.
﻿
And..done ! 

Hope you'll enjoy my work and stay tuned for more (I have plans for Haley after this one)
